Learn the lesson: price is not market cap!

A few things from this DeFi chart:

• HYPE passed UNI's 2021 peak: $24.43B vs $22.59B. DeFi can still produce new winners while many OG tokens struggle to recover.

• 10 of the 20 tokens peaked in market cap in 2021. UNI, AAVE, COMP... five years later and those highs still haven't been beaten.

• MORPHO reached its price ATH of $4.17 in Jan 2025. Its MC went higher later as more tokens entered circulation, while buyers near the price ATH were still underwater.

• Unlocks and emissions make 'getting back to ATH' harder. If circulating supply triples, reaching the old price requires 3x the old market cap.

TL;DR on the five Defi protocols:

• @mezzanine_fi: Yield vaults where you choose more yield and more risk, or less yield with other depositors taking losses before you.

• @Infinit_Labs: Let managers trade for you on Hyperliquid. Their own money takes the first losses.

• @iris_credit: Borrow using Aave/Morpho liquidity at a fixed interest rate. You know what you'll pay upfront.

• @risextrade: A fully onchain perps exchange. Other DeFi apps can build on it, combining borrowing and trading in one tx.

• @boros_fi: Bet on funding rates going up/down, or lock in the funding rate on your existing perp positions.
